**⚠⚠ THE SEVENTY-SIX RULES (headline forms; unabridged pre-w17):** 1 CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2 NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3 FLOOD CELLS. 4 COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/STACKS. 5 A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP. 7 THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 A REPAIR PASS MUST NOT RE-CREATE DELIBERATE REMOVALS. 9 SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 A CELL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN ACTION. 12 A FOREIGN SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 ASK WHAT IS AT THE DESTINATION. 15 ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 COUNT THE WRITE PATHS — vanilla's and the ENGINE's (§91b; §92; §95 closed-generic flecks; §95E position-blind PostDraw; §95E2 Internal_DrawMesh funnel; §96 BASE-grid pixel filter). 17 A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX (§96 lived it; **§97 lives it now: no desk mechanism for the TO report → repro must lead**) + decompile the binary. 18 NEVER EXONERATE ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE (§96 reopened the _MapSize disproof). 19 `TicksGame` RESTARTS. 20 EARLIER WORK TURNS ON EVERY READINESS GATE. 21 THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL (§96 base-grid ghost CHECKED and cleared). 22 A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN. 23 AUDIT THE WEIGHTING. 24 CLAMP THE TARGET TOO. 25 A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS TOO LATE. 26 PASS THE RENDERER'S GATE. 27 SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 A FICTION FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS FACT TO THE REST. 29 REPORT OUTCOMES. 30 A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN. 31 MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE. 32 A TICK CARRIES SERVICES. 33 A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO (§87.b's TargetMethods names every unresolved exclusion). 34 INVISIBLE = ABSENT FROM EVERY LAYER. 35 A CLONED DEF IS IN NO LOOKUPS. 36 RUN VANILLA'S PREDICATE. 37 NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT. 38 OWN THE DRAW — AT THE FUNNEL, even the engine's. 39 LAST WRITE ≠ SETTLED TARGET. 40 A TRIPWIRE BEFORE THE OBSERVER IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 AN UNSET FIELD IS AN UNSHIPPED FEATURE. 42 READ-DIRECTION IS THE THING'S PROPERTY. 43 DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION. 44 A WHOLE OFFSET ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT. 45 TRAVEL ≠ ELEVATION. 46 SCALE × ROTATION = SHEAR. 47 A CACHED CURSOR CELL IS A COORDINATE ASSUMPTION. 48 A WRITE READ BACK BY ITS CALLER IS NOT A WRITE. 49 A TEST FOR A SAYS NOTHING ABOUT B. 50 TWO OWN PATCHES CANCEL SILENTLY. 51 A FACTORY CONSUMED ITS INPUT. 52 AN OVERLAY ASKS THE CLICK'S QUESTION, READ-ONLY. 53 A PREDICATE IS CLOSED OVER ITS CALLER'S ARGS. 54 SEARCH THE CAPABILITY. 55 FALLBACK JOBS COUNT. 56 RANK-VS-FILTER FINDS THE BLIND SPOT. 57 TWO "WHICH SIDE" ANSWERS = ONE WRONG. 58 ART ≠ DEF. 59 MEASURE size FROM THE DRAWING. 60 MEASURE THE PIXELS. 61 A COLOURED GRAPHIC IS A DIFFERENT OBJECT. 62 FINISHED-ANSWER TABLES ROT. 63 MEASURE PATIENCE FROM ITS EVENT. 64 OFF-BY-DEFAULT DIAGNOSTICS DON'T EXIST; `#if DEBUG` is off for players. 65 THE FOURTH FAILURE IS A DEFECTIVE INPUT. 66 A DESTINATION DOESN'T CONSTRAIN ENTRY SIDE. 67 ASK WHO SENT THE NEW ORDER. 68 TWICE ON ONE DEF = THE DEF'S RULE. 69 SUSPENDING A DRIVER INHERITS ITS REQUESTS. 70 OPT-IN AT N CONSUMERS = WRONG LAYER (**§87.b is its newest instance: a consumer class that meant RAW, fixed by one more exclusion**). 71 "THE" OCCUPANT CANNOT SEE A STACK. 72 A NAMED-BUILDING DESTINATION OUTLIVES CORRECTIONS. 73 A PROBE COMPUTING ITS OWN ANSWER ISN'T READING. 74 NAME THE DENOMINATOR. 75 CROSS-BAND LENGTH PRICES NORTH AS UP. 76 VERIFY THE WINNER.
